ck: ranasupa_23 (ra.) itan tu potyan-natyanate evan tarnan prtak pasyan ityatisrutyanurotenananayatvaprananayatvatitarnanan anatvapranatvatitarnananananayatisariranan ca prahnatyantapinatayananayopatesena anan prahneti vyacanat ityatina prahnopatesacnanayornispanataya prananayatyupatesasya prano prahneti vyacanat ityate, punareva varunan pitaranupasasara ityatesca vEyartyanasakatyan ca turvaraneva, tatatarnasariranan prahnatyanapinataya tarnapetena va sarirapetena va punarprahnopatesatacnanayorvaktunayuktatvatiti, yatuktan, kantanan_23 (kan.) tatacan, yata sve nahini pratistita ityatavapetepi atarateyapavanirvahastatatasataranavastusvarupaparaparyayena svapavavisesena, tatananavatirupananapetepi visesapalateva punarprahnopatesacnanayo nirvahakaranat, katarupayorapetepi katasya cnatataya rupasyacnatataya svapavavisesena tvaya nirvahasya krtatvat ॐ anantanayopyasat ॐ sitante atikaranasvarupan tu- "tasnatva etasnatvicnananayatanyontara atnanantanaya” iti tEtiriyasrutavanantanayasaptapratipatya visaya kin caturnuka ki rutra rka civa kin va visnuriti santeha anantanaya caturnuko pavet, caturnukavacakasatanantasaptasananartaka saptapratipatyatvat rutro va pavet, rutratikaranasuryataratvat civo va pavet, civapinanyananananaya kosaprayapatitatvat na tu visnu tasyavikaritvena nayatantasaptapotyananta vikaritvasanpavatiti purvapakse, tasya ca sokanayata iti cakatkaranatvoktya na prahnana cakatkaranatvan laksanan sanpavatiti prapte anantanayasaptapratipatya visnureva, visnavasatarana prahnasaptasyasat na ca vikarartakanayatantanantasaptavacyatvan na sanpavatiti vacyan nayata pracuryartatvat na ca vikarartanayatatananayatiprayapatavirota, ananayatisvapi visnvasatarananan prahnasaptatinan satvena tesanapi visnutvena tatkatanayatanapi pracuryartatvat anantanayasya prahnatve tatavayavasya prahnapucan pratista iti prahnatvoktivirutyate iti na sakyan, prahnavayavavayavinorapetatiti yat,
